verdict.rationale: GitLab documents GitHub importer functionality and community evidence confirms repo/issue/PR migration works straightforwardly, but evidence lacks detail on user migration or self-hosted-to-cloud (SaaS) migration tooling specifically. missing for 10: dedicated self-hosted-to-cloud migration docs, user/account migration tooling, first-party migration guides beyond GitHub importer, independent validation of self-managed-to-SaaS migration success.
